rules: predeclare condition, outcome, sequence, observation period, comparison, stopping rule, and interpretation boundary
show order, repetition, confounders, missingness, uncertainty, and alternate explanations
do not convert a difference into causation, diagnosis, treatment, durable personal effect, or population evidence
do not collect health, disability, biometric, location, workplace, school, or identifiable data
stop and seek appropriate professional or emergency help rather than experimenting when safety or health is at issue
